title: Coast Guard, Navy medevac ill mariner from sailing vessel north of Oahu
description: 160710-G-IA651-004 PACIFIC OCEAN (July 10, 2016) The crew of an HC-130 Hercules airplane flies cover and manages communications for a Navy SH-60 crew on a medevac of an ill mariner from the sailing vessel Second Chance. The Coast Guard monitored the mariner's condition for several days until the vessel was within range of aircrews capable of medevacing the 58-year-old mariner 184 north of Oahu. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Connor Mitchell/Released)
